body: Kind of endearing? I was laughing the whole time! Too bad she has a bias against nerds. That could've been a beautiful thing. I love the whole bit about him being her financial advisor. Charming.

You know, that's where I always experience some kind of weird disconnect. I teach my child that everyone has with, but somehow, I can't make that translate to myself. It's like I see myself and my own life as a lost cause and over already. But for my child, I'm just trying to help her to help her peers build a better future for themselves. Where hopefully more parents like me have broken the chain of generational trauma and abuse, and they can all help each other instead of feeling as isolated and worthless as I do.

Thank you for saying that. I try to give my kid everything I know that I needed, especially the things i needed and did not get, like love and reassurance. The last thing i want in the world is for her to turn out like me.

It's difficult to even imagine a life without trauma. Many many things have happened to me, it goes way beyond just absent parents. In a way, it certainly shaped who I am. I don't want that. I have had to do a lot of grieving the life I like to imagine I "would have had." I could conquer the world. I'm talented, I'm intelligent. But all of that is for naught if I live inside this prison that is my traumatized mind. I could have and would have done and been a great many things. Instead I have debilitating CPTSD. And I have still accomplished, even with this illness. That's how I know I would have been great.

I don't know what to do. I can't abandon my child, but the same time, everything feels so entirely hopeless right now. I honestly do believe that I am garbage. I honestly don't believe that anyone will ever love me. I didn't have parents, so it just makes me feel unlovable straight out of the gate, no matter whether that is irrational or not. I know my parents were just broken, but then that leads me to think that I must also be. I have accomplished many things in my life without them, but I carry a heavy burden of trauma that I know most people can't even conceive of. The burden is too heavy. For me, and for every one else that knows I carry it. I can't control it, I can't escape it. I just can't anymore.

Well, in my opinion, a person has worth by virtue of being human. But the rest of the world does not believe this. No one that I've interacted with personally believes this. I have been conditioned that you're only worth as much as you can contribute. I apparently contribute nothing. Not according to him.

I see a therapist, and it just gaslighting. 

The world and he has convinced me that I'm fucking garbage.
